02 · What Phase 1 taught us

Three things the data told us.

01

A specific situation beats a general topic

The guarantor-liability post drew 172 reactions against a median of 67. Naming one exact borrower problem outperformed broad financial advice.

2.57× the median
02

Pain is what makes people write

The post about income suddenly stopping produced the highest comment count we reviewed: 19. Hardship makes people describe their own situation in public.

Highest comment count reviewed
03

A creator reaches people we cannot

The PF collaboration reached 479 reactions. Not a followers play: it borrows an audience that already trusts someone else on exactly this subject.

7.15× the median

What these numbers mean. Reactions are public likes. Comments are public replies. Median is the middle value across the 15 recent posts reviewed, a fairer baseline than an average because one collaboration pulls the average upward. These are public counts, not Instagram Insights reach.

03 · The CEO discussion

Four decisions changed after speaking to Anurag.

Audience

Distress stage, not age

Age helps us choose examples. Financial stage decides who can actually act on what we say.

Attribution

Source quality

Current organic figures may carry paid-media spillover, so they show demand rather than proof.

Creative

Repeatable reach

Education needs a recognisable entertainment format, not only situation explainers.

Brand

Format-led personality

The premise and script carry the show, so different team members can perform it.

Phase 2 therefore needs two engines

High-intent content creates qualified demand. A smaller recurring series earns new reach and brings fresh people into the profile.

6 / 30
04 · The two jobs of Phase 2

Phase 2 has two jobs, not one.

The first continues the promise Phase 1 closed on. The second is new, and it is where enquiries come from.

Job one · keep earning reach

Win the first three seconds

Skip rate was the strongest predictor of reach in Phase 1, and only 10 of 43 reels held attention past the 60% line. Every point of skip rate we recover is reach we do not have to buy. The mini-series is how this scales beyond hooks alone.

Hook, opening frame and first line stay under test
Job two · turn reach into enquiries

Give every post somewhere to go

Reach that ends at the caption is reach that ends. Each borrower situation gets its own keyword, free resource and landing route, so the team can see which topic produced which consultation.

Five pathways, five resources, one source tag each

Job one keeps the top of the funnel full. Job two decides what happens to the people in it. Neither works alone.

7 / 30
04 · How job one runs

Three hooks per reel. The data picks the winner.

Standing procedure from Phase 1, carried forward unchanged. Every reel is written with three genuinely different openings, all three are trialled unlisted, and only the one that holds attention gets published.

Hook AHook BHook C

Average watch time is the primary signal, then reach, saves and shares. Note the constraint: Instagram now suppresses variations that differ by only one line, so the three openings have to be genuinely distinct, not re-cuts.

05 · Customer fit

The primary customer sits inside an action window.

This is the sharpest change from the CEO discussion. Not everyone in debt is a customer: the service needs someone whose distress is visible and whose capacity to act still exists.

Still coping
Often above 730
Minimum dues, card rotation and fresh borrowing, but nothing has broken yet.
Nurture and reveal the risk
The action window
Often 600 to 730
Visible distress, with enough income or family support to act on a plan.
Assessment and consultation
Prolonged default
Often below 600
Long default history and repeated recovery exposure, past the point the service fits.
Realistic education or referral

Credit score is one signal, not the test. The credit report and the wider financial position together show the fuller situation. The bands are directional, for content targeting, not an eligibility rule.

05 · The other three

Each one needs a different promise.

PLAN / GUARANTOR

The family protector

Income shock, household responsibility or guarantor exposure. Often the only earner. Needs evidence, a real expert and sometimes the family in the room.

Sequence, documents and an expert conversation
CALLS

The harassment-first borrower

Calls, messages or visits creating immediate urgency. That urgency also makes people vulnerable to whoever promises the most.

Evidence guidance, rights education and triage
VERIFY

The sceptical comparison shopper

Questions about legitimacy, fees and consequences. They will not enquire until these are answered plainly.

Service scope, payment safety and complaint routes

One person moves between these as their situation changes. A quiet rotator becomes a harassment case the month an EMI bounces, so the pathways are built to support that movement rather than restart it.

11 / 30
06 · Distress journey

The trigger starts the content story.

Debt is not the opening scene. Something causes it, the household copes, the coping hides it, and only then does anyone look for help. Content that starts at the trigger reaches people earlier than content that starts at the debt.

1
Trigger
Job loss, medical emergency, business loss, marriage, fraud or education debt.
2
Coping
Savings, the minimum due, card rotation or a new loan.
3
Warning signs
More accounts, recent enquiries, missed payments or gold loans.
4
Delay
The household keeps managing while the debt quietly grows.
5
Action
Assessment, when distress is visible and capacity still exists.
The content formula

Trigger + coping behaviour + warning sign + consequence of delay + one safe next action.

07 · Shared vocabulary

Funnel terms, in plain language.

These three words appear on every slide that follows, so it is worth fixing what each one means for this account before the numbers arrive.

ToFu · top of funnel

People who do not know the brand, or do not yet recognise the problem

Entertainment, relatable situations and creator reach. This is what the mini-series is for.

MoFu · middle of funnel

People who recognise the problem and are checking options or credibility

Tools, cases, process, privacy and consequences.

BoFu · bottom of funnel

People whose situation is urgent enough to consider a consultation

Specific distress scenarios and assessment routes.

And what counts as a qualified lead

Someone who fits the service, has enough capacity to act, and shows intent beyond a form submission.

09 · Content allocation

A 10-2-3 monthly mix balances leads and reach.

Fifteen reels a month, weighted to the bottom of the funnel because that is where consultations come from, with a fixed minority reserved for reach.

10
67%
BoFu
Six situation stories, two diagnostics and two service or process reels. The lead engine.
2
13%
MoFu
One useful tool and one trust or proof reel, for people checking options and credibility.
3
20%
Mini-series
Three episodes of one recurring entertainment format, earning reach beyond the current audience.

Why three and not more. Three episodes a month establish a pattern without turning the account into a comedy page. The series is there to bring new people in, not to become the brand.

10 · Creative platform

Flagship mini-series: The EMI Situation Room.

Premise

A normal moment reveals a debt warning

A household or workplace scene exposes the gap between what the character says and what the numbers actually show.

Personality

The format carries recognition

Recurring roles and a consistent writing style let different team members perform it. No celebrity acting required.

Safety

The borrower is never the joke

Observational humour only. Never ridicule borrowers or lenders, and never imply a guaranteed outcome.

Episode rhythm
0-3 sec hook3-15 sec conflict15-25 sec reveal25-35 sec useful actionCTA

This is the answer to "education needs a recognisable entertainment format". It is a format, not a personality, which is what makes it survivable if a performer changes.

11 · CTA continuity

A CTA only works when it appears in three places.

This is the most common thing we lose. The keyword is said on camera, then missing from the caption, or present in the caption and missing from the bio. Any one gap breaks the pathway and the lead becomes untraceable.

Place 01Spoken, on cameraThe presenter says the keyword out loud, near the end, once and clearly.
Place 02Caption and pinned commentThe same keyword, written, plus what to comment or where to go.
Place 03Link in bioThe bio link points to the landing page matching that week's keyword.
Standing procedure from day one

Every post ships against this checklist before it goes live. We build it, hand it to the Expert Panel team, and check it as part of the weekly review.

12 · Evidence boundary

Current lead numbers show demand, not clean attribution.

120Reported form leads
80 to 85Initial consultation payments
22Reported further progress
Why the conclusion is limited

Some users may see paid media, visit the Instagram profile and then submit through the bio or the website. Link changes and incomplete Zoho separation can make that journey appear organic.

The decision. Use these figures as evidence of intent. Do not claim that specific reels created them until source tagging is fixed. That fix is the first thing Phase 2 builds, and it is why the 90-day plan opens with attribution rather than content.

Sixty days validates the format. Ninety days builds the volume.

The monthly shape
10 BoFu reelsSituation, diagnostic, service
2 MoFu reelsOne tool, one trust or proof
3 mini-seriesOne recurring format
15 reels a monthThe working shape
The 90-day commitment
48 reelsFour a week
12 carouselsOne a week
24 controlled testsTwo a week, one variable each
4 creator pilotsPlus 5 resources, 5 landing routes
Weeks 1-2
Foundation
  • Fix source tags
  • Define stages
  • Write six episodes
Weeks 3-4
First test
  • 6 BoFu reels
  • 2 MoFu reels
  • 2 series episodes
Weeks 5-6
Second test
  • Next content cycle
  • Third series episode
  • Pathway comparison
Weeks 7-8
Decision
  • Review mature cohorts
  • Refine distribution
  • Approve next run

The two numbers reconcile. Fifteen reels a month is the working shape, 48 over 90 days is the commitment, and 100% source tagging applies to every lead-generating post in both. Decision rule: continue the series only when it improves relevant non-follower reach and profile movement.

16 · Measurement

The scorecard separates reach from business value.

Non-follower reachDoes the format expand beyond the current audience?
Three-second and midpoint retentionDoes the hook attract attention, and does the conflict sustain it?
Profile visits per 1,000 viewsDoes the entertainment create curiosity about Expert Panel?
Relevant comments and keyword actionsDoes the viewer connect the story with a real financial problem?
Qualified consultations per 1,000 non-follower viewsDoes the format contribute suitable demand, directly or through later profile exposure?
Non-follower viewsViews from accounts that do not follow the page, separate from paid reach.
QualifiedFits the service, has capacity to act, shows intent beyond a form.
AttendedThe prospect actually joined the scheduled consultation.
Independent intentExcludes known employees, partners and repeat commenters.

Views tell us whether the format travelled. Qualified progression tells us whether it mattered. Followers are the wrong scoreboard here: Phase 1 gained roughly 262 organically while producing the lead volume above.

28 / 30
16 · Compliance

Growth stays inside clear boundaries.

Always do
  • Cite the rule, its date and whether it is draft or final
  • State that borrower protections do not cancel the debt
  • Show scope, fees, official payment and the complaint route
  • State lender discretion and possible credit impact
Never say
  • RBI approved or RBI affiliated, without a verified basis
  • Guaranteed settlement, reduction or waiver
  • A permanent stop to every call or visit
  • Guaranteed credit repair, or advice to stop paying
Privacy
  • No PAN, Aadhaar, card or bank credentials in comments or DMs
  • Anonymise every consultation transcript before creative sees it
  • Collect only through the approved secure form
Series-specific
  • The borrower is never the joke
  • No lender impersonation or legal certainty
  • Label AI-assisted assets, the platform tag cannot be disabled

Compliance review applies before every public lead-generating post. RBI instructions apply to regulated entities and their agents: Expert Panel can explain borrower protections, and should never present itself as RBI approved.
